data_provenance: Synthetic teaching fixture, no real customer, retailer or production data.
definition: Apply explicitly supplied merge ranking to symbols; not a learned production tokenizer. Tiny smoothed conditional count model p=(count+1)/(4+4). Evaluation loss is mean negative natural log for three stated targets, perplexity exp(loss). Synthetic scaling law L(C)=1+2*C^(-0.5) with normalized dimensionless C.
checks: no claims tiny count model is LLM or scaling fit predicts actual spend
